study_plan_snapshot.user_scope: Run the experiments from all four stages of the supplied six-week plan now, using the local machine, and publish the completed artifact to the specified GitHub repository.
study_plan_snapshot.old_results: Immutable. New data, model runs and analyses use new directories.

population.scope: Fictional tenant-specific collections. All variants of a latent world remain in one split. A collection contains no other variant of the same world. This tests conditional mechanisms, not open-domain population prevalence.
population.policy: Balanced open/constrained assignment by world; paired variants share policy.
population.templates: Development prose/list; test includes seen expression families and a held-out QA family. Rendering choices and parameter ranges are not revised to obtain test effects.

statistics.unit: latent world; average paired-variant differences within each world before inference
statistics.interval: paired world bootstrap 95%, stratified by generation seed
statistics.primary_multiple_comparisons: Holm adjustment for two primary comparisons
statistics.p_values: 20,000 world-level paired sign flips under a symmetry/exchangeability null, with seed 20261002. This is a model-based test, not evidence of randomized population assignment. All-zero differences yield p=1 and a degenerate empirical interval, not an equivalence claim.
statistics.exploration: Other factors, templates, policies, seeds, subgroups and secondary endpoints are exploratory; keep all null, reversed and infeasible observations.
statistics.weights: equal latent worlds; simulator mixture weights are designed, not estimated real-world frequencies

mechanisms.matrix: Main 28 budget/cap configurations plus predefined targeted submatrices, deduplicated. Exact configuration records are frozen in the backend manifest before scoring.
mechanisms.no_loss_controls: Candidate counts within cap, and redundant support retained; verify as specified controls, not by accepting only worlds with desired outcomes.
mechanisms.stage_accounting: Candidate absence, pre-cap, post-cap and final budget. Pure sorting preserves full-set support membership.

downstream.selection: Deterministic stratified sampling before inference; 20 worlds per generation seed, both variants retained.
controls: evidence from a deterministically different world without target support
downstream.response: JSON with one value and evidence-source label for each requested fact; unknown for unsupported fields
downstream.evaluation: Exact fictional fact values, complete correctness, per-field correctness, cited evidence support and unsupported-field abstention. No LLM judge is treated as human annotation.
downstream.prompt_cost: Record full prompt tokens and generated tokens under the answer tokenizer, separate from the BERT evidence budget.

online_timing.selection: Deterministic test-world sample fixed before outcomes, spanning seeds and templates
online_timing.order: Seeded random request/configuration order; CUDA synchronized around whole requests
online_timing.cache_policy: No reused query embeddings or reranker scores in timed requests. Offline document indexes and resident weights are reused as in a warm service.
online_timing.interpretation: Local request latency on fictional inputs; no production-throughput or real-user latency claim.

human_audit.automated_audit: Independently parse rendered assertions and reconcile with fact tables and delivered text; do not relabel automatic checks as human review.

publication.authorization: Explicit user instruction to upload on 2026-10-02
publication.completion_criterion: Verify committed repository files and downloadable artifacts after upload; report any remaining access blocker honestly.

design.independent_unit: latent world; both variants remain in one group
design.collection_scope: Independent 80-chunk tenant collection; no other variant or world is searchable
design.paired_intervention: Only source URL concentration changes; ordered document texts, questions, hosts and facts are identical
design.support_position: Independent continuous fraction Uniform(0.05,0.95), rendered with full sentences; actual token visibility is measured later
design.range_rationale: Finite mechanism stress ranges spanning short/long contexts; no empirical deployment-frequency claim
design.heldout_fraction: floor(test_per_seed/2) worlds per seed; heldout grammar receives structural audit but no model tuning
design.policy_assignment: Balanced synthetic design assignment within each seed/split; not a real-world frequency estimate
design.acceptance: No model-score, effect-size, significance or nonzero-gap acceptance criterion
